description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git command behaviors, particularly focusing on different syntax combinations of @{X} references within the Git version control system. It includes setup commands, test functions, and various test cases to verify the behavior of ref log references, the use of '@' symbols, and associated Git operations.

methods.name: check
methods.description: A function to evaluate expected Git command outputs against actual results, using parameters for the command, type of Git object, expected value, and success/failure expectation.

methods.name: nonsense
methods.description: A function to test invalid or nonsensical @{X} syntax, expecting failure from 'git rev-parse --verify'.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: A wrapper to execute a command expecting failure, appending 'failure' to the invocation.
